turns.speaker: knight
turns.content: Merlinus! I have learned to build a {{gold:strong password}}, but tell me — how does a machine actually break a weak one?

turns.speaker: mage
turns.content: Ah, Data Protector, machines are tireless. They try thousands of {{cyan:guesses}} every second — starting with common words, names, and birthdays.

turns.speaker: knight
turns.content: Then a long, unique passphrase truly is our best shield against such an onslaught!

turns.speaker: mage
turns.content: Precisely. A passphrase like {{code:Castle-Moat-Dragon-99!}} would take far longer to guess than any single dictionary word. Length and uniqueness are thy true armor.

turns.speaker: knight
turns.content: Then I shall forge a unique passphrase for every gate I guard, and never the same key twice!
